verdict.rationale: v0 explicitly supports generating full-stack apps from a prompt, including backend logic and database connections (v0-docs-15, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-28, v0-docs-35), and a community report confirms building a feature-rich app with auth, roles, and export functionality from v0 (v0-comm-1). Missing for 10: a first-party walkthrough showing a single prompt producing both UI and backend code side-by-side, and more independent technical validation of backend logic quality.
